craft_notes: Sthāyin: dark-doors (bad night, dark fortnight — timira as NAME of contemplation). Rows: row 2 (contemplating→will come). Close: come (eṣyati — future: the form WILL come — futurity as promise). Rejected: 'timira-sādhana' tech-label — killed: contemplating timira kept plain; 'nightmare' — killed: bad night kept (dur-nīśā as weather, not evil).

lines: Bad night, dark fortnight, long in it:
contemplating timira — Bhairava's form will come.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evam eva durniśāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣāgame ciram | taimiram bhāvayan rūpam bhairavaṃ rūpam eṣyati

reads_against.argmap: What works in the darkest night? → Contemplating darkness itself, the Bhairava form is reached.
c1_essence: Dark night, dark fortnight: contemplating timira, form comes.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with adbhuta (stillness startled by its own gates)
